description: Only bin/lib/main-guard.ts compares a module with process.argv[1]. Entry points (bin/pensmith.ts, mcp/server.ts, hook entries) call isMainModule(import.meta.url), which compares realpaths (case-folded on Windows), so npm i -g, npm link, node_modules/.bin shims, symlinked plugin roots and Windows junctions run instead of exiting 0 silently; a hand-rolled `import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href` guard is false under every symlink.
